rubric.role_summary: Frontend software engineer building performant interfaces for finance and spend-management products, contributing to complex projects and mentoring less experienced engineers.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Frontend software engineer building performant interfaces for finance and spend-management products, contributing to complex projects and mentoring less experienced engineers.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Proficiency in JavaScript and React.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- At least 2 years of frontend engineering experience.
- Track record of shipping products and developing projects at scale.
- Experience turning business and product ideas into engineering solutions.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): New York metropolitan area; San Francisco Bay Area, California; Greater Miami, FL area; United States; Canada. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
